history.description: AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.8: Fixed protected Superadmin actions after database reset by recovering signed Superadmin sessions whose previous user row was removed.; Prevented duplicate Superadmin bootstrap records and improved expired-session messaging for attendance Excel export.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.7: Redesigned candidate ID cards with uploaded photos, QR verification, AKV and white Acharya logos, Kannada-only branding, and bundled Noto Sans Kannada and Outfit fonts.; Added reliable authenticated ID card and event pass PDF downloads with photo persistence on registrations.; Compressed Superadmin Daily Attendance Records to a no-horizontal-scroll layout with Reg ID, Name, AUID, AKV Dept, Status, and Superadmin Power controls.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.6: Fixed Excel Export AutoFilter XML corruption: Resolved OpenPyXL single-row filter range error on empty domain sheets across 15-Sheet Official Attendance and Working Committee workbooks.; FastAPI CORS header exposure: Added expose_headers=['Content-Disposition'] enabling browsers to extract dynamic server-generated file names.; Robust IST Timezone Formatter: Made format_to_ist_time and format_to_ist_datetime accept both datetime objects and ISO strings safely.; Export Request Sanitization & Error Handling: Stripped empty query string filters in api.js and surfaced human-readable backend error messages if export fails.; SuperAdmin Dashboard Export Suite: Added dedicated Working Committee Workbook (.xlsx) export card alongside the 15-sheet festival workbook and raw CSV downloads with loading indicators.; Comprehensive Portal Regression Testing: Successfully validated all 27 critical functions (System health, Auth, Student portal, Pass generation, Check-in verification & revert, SuperAdmin admin approvals, Multi-day attendance, Activity management, Audit logs) with zero errors.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.5: Fixed Admin Approval Requests reaching SuperAdmin: Converted blocking synchronous SMTP dispatches in admin registration, password reset, and approvals to non-blocking FastAPI BackgroundTasks (<50ms response).; Multi-Relay SMTP Circuit Breaker: Added 120s cooldown on failing relays to eliminate timeouts and prevent 504 Gateway errors on Vercel.; Eliminated False Offline Fallback: Restricted api.js localStorage fallback to strictly offline status (!navigator.onLine), ensuring real server errors are visible and avoiding trapped registrations.; SuperAdmin Notification Broadcasting: Registration alerts are now broadcast to all SuperAdmin email addresses in a single envelope transaction.; SuperAdmin Dashboard Enhancements: Added urgent pending admin approvals banner on Overview, segmented filter controls (All, Pending Review, Approved), and real-time approval queues.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.4: Removed dev reset token UI from Forgot Password modal, fixed input font contrast and visibility, and engineered Multi-Relay SMTP Pool with automatic failover and load balancing.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.3: 10-minute time-limited password reset link delivery from akv@acharya.ac.in, automated candidate & participant confirmation email dispatch with attached official ID Card & Event Pass PDF, verification QR codes, and admin coordinator recovery.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.1: Multi-day 2-marking attendance system, server IST timestamps, submit locks, SuperAdmin privilege suite & audit trail, dedicated Working Committee attendance, exclusive SuperAdmin 15-sheet Excel export, and Admin Coordinator gallery fix.
AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.1.1: Erased legacy mock profiles, retained only official SuperAdmin accounts, and secured authentication
AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.1.0: Cultural gallery, Major AKV activities, Reels management, Candidate photo upload, Semester & Institute selection, Superadmin security, and Check-In access restrictions.
Production PostgreSQL migration, authentication improvements, and architecture documentation.
